info.name: CRMPro API — Complete
info.description:
CRMPro API — complete local development collection.

Import with crmpro-local.postman_environment.json.

Base URL: {{baseUrl}} = http://localhost:3000/api/v1

Folders: Auth, Pipelines, Lead Sources, Developers, Projects, Leads, Files, Import/Export Jobs, Tasks, Calendar, Analytics, Notifications, Automations, Monitoring, Debug.

Start: Auth → Login, then run module folders.

List tenant pipelines (paginated, searchable, sortable).

**Query:** `page`, `limit` (max 100), `search` (pipeline name), `sortBy` (`name`|`createdAt`), `sortOrder` (`asc`|`desc`).

Defaults: page=1, limit=20, sortBy=createdAt, sortOrder=asc.

request.description: Get a single pipeline by ID. Run **List Pipelines** first to set `pipelineId`.
Create a pipeline with 7 default system stages (New Lead → Lost).
Update pipeline name or default flag.
Delete a non-default pipeline with no leads. Fails for default pipeline or pipelines with leads.
Insert a custom stage at sortOrder. Stages at or after that position shift down (+1). Example: sortOrder 4 inserts before Interested and renumbers later stages.
Update stage fields. Closed stages require closeType (WON or LOST).

item.name: Lead Sources
item.description: Lead acquisition channel management. Agents have read-only access.

request.description:
List lead sources (paginated, searchable, sortable).

**Query:** `page`, `limit` (max 100), `search` (source name), `sortBy` (`name`|`createdAt`), `sortOrder` (`asc`|`desc`).

Defaults: page=1, limit=20, sortBy=name, sortOrder=asc.
Get a single lead source. Run **List Lead Sources** first to set `leadSourceId`.
Create a lead source. Names must be unique per tenant (case-insensitive).
Update a lead source name.
Delete a lead source not referenced by any leads.

item.name: Developers
item.description: Real estate developer management. Agents have read-only access.

request.description: List developers (paginated, searchable, sortable). Excludes soft-deleted rows.
Get a single developer. Run **List Developers** first to set `developerId`.
Create a developer. Names must be unique per tenant among active developers.
Update developer name.
Soft-delete a developer with no active projects.

item.name: Projects
item.description: Real estate project management. Agents have read-only access.

request.description: List projects (paginated, searchable, sortable). Excludes soft-deleted rows. Includes developer summary.

Create a project. Run **List Developers** first to set `developerId`. Names must be unique per tenant among active projects.
Update project fields (developerId, name, location, isActive).
Soft-delete a project. Does not block when linked to leads.

item.name: Files
item.description: Signed S3 upload flow (Phase 1). Run Auth → Login first.

request.description: Step 1: get signed upload URL. Max 25 MB. Quota checked against tenant plan. `sizeBytes` is the declared maximum; the S3 object may be smaller but not larger.
Step 2: PUT the file bytes to S3 using the presigned URL from step 1. Body must be ≤ declared `sizeBytes` and use the same Content-Type. No Bearer token.
Step 3: after client PUT to S3 (required — complete fails with 400 if object missing). Persist FileAsset.
Get signed download URL for a file.
Soft-delete FileAsset, remove from S3, decrement tenant storage.

item.name: Import Jobs
item.description: Lead CSV import jobs (Phase 1). Upload a CSV as IMPORT_FILE via Files flow first, or use a seeded fileAssetId after db seed.

request.description: Creates a PENDING import job and starts processing asynchronously. Requires `import-job.create`. CSV headers: fullName, primaryPhone (required); secondaryPhone, email, sourceName, assignedUserEmail (optional). Extra columns are ignored.
Poll job status until COMPLETED, PARTIAL_SUCCESS, or FAILED.
Paginated list, newest first. Requires `import-job.read`.

item.name: Export Jobs

request.description: Requires export-job.create. Saves exportJobId.

item.name: Tasks
item.description: Task management — CRUD, status transitions, assignment, dashboard. Requires `task.*` permissions.

request.description: Paginated task list. Filters: assignedUserId, leadId, projectId, priority, status, type, overdueOnly, from, to, search.
Returns pending, completedToday, overdue, dueToday, completionRate, averageCompletionTimeHours.
